offering_description.value: Provides galvanizing and coil coating services that protect steel and aluminum from corrosion and improve their appearance for industrial and construction customers.

primary_services.value: Hot-dip galvanizing; metal coil coating and finishing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Steel fabricators, metal producers, construction suppliers and manufacturers

end_markets.value: Construction; infrastructure; electrical utilities; transportation; appliances; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: service fees: Customers pay for galvanizing and coating metal, generally based on material processed and finishing requirements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Processes customer-supplied fabricated steel and metal coils for fabricators and manufacturers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

company_size.value: Large North American metal coating services provider with a broad network of industrial processing facilities

specialization.value: related lines: Galvanizing fabricated steel and coating metal coils share a focus on protective metal finishing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sells coating and galvanizing services directly to industrial customers through its processing facility network

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Metal finishing operations face EPA and state environmental requirements for emissions, wastewater and hazardous waste, plus OSHA workplace safety rules

notes: Based on model knowledge of AZZ's metal coatings businesses following its divestiture of majority ownership in its infrastructure solutions business; current operations were not independently verified.
